description:
What is this Part?
This is the Parking Brake Cable #2 for the Suzuki Samurai.
This cable goes from the Left Rear Brake Lever Assembly to the Right Rear Brake Lever Assembly
This cable is for the US/American Left Hand Drive Model
Direct Replacement
Note: There is also an Emergency Brake Cable #1 which is sold separately
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Parking Brake Cable #2 (LHD)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
